points.text: Signs you've hit the ceiling of vibe coding:
Three eras of programming (Karpathy: Software 2.0 — a 2017 essay, Software 3.0 — a 2025 talk):
A vibe coder lives in 3.0 and uses a single neural "worker." An agent engineer lives in 3.0 and orchestrates a team of neural workers.
